value.rationale: A natural newly studied base-point recurrence radius receives an exact operator-wide classification on all Hilbert-space contractions, not just individual compact/stable examples. The formula exposes sharp invariant geometric sectors and distinguishes three physically different spectral regimes (unimodular atomic: 0, stable: 1, persistent continuous: 2 in squared norm). The weighted forward shift with a single damped edge realizes a truly intermediate threshold. This is a motivated and reusable structural theorem.
